content: The use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) is particularly advantageous for older adults, especially those diagnosed with type 1 diabetes, as it facilitates better management of glucose variability and significantly decreases the risk of hypoglycemia. Advanced insulin delivery systems, such as automated insulin delivery (AID) devices and hybrid closed-loop systems, have demonstrated superior efficacy in achieving improved blood glucose control while minimizing the duration of hypoglycemia. Clinical evidence from trials like WISDM (Wireless Innovation for Seniors with Diabetes Mellitus) and ORACL (Older Adults Researching Closed-Loop) strongly supports the effectiveness of these advanced technologies in managing diabetes among older populations.
